notes.title: Super Catscape for Windows and Mac finally here!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to introduce our official release of Super Catscape v1.0.1 available both for Windows and MacOs!

The game was under development for the last couple of years in collaboration with MST Design School. It was awarded the Best Sound and Best Music at the Mexico's National Videogames Contest 2018 edition. Please visit our website for more information about Nuke Games, our digital store with official merch and more!

Let us know any comments, reviews and public relations inquiries at developers@nukegames.mx

Enjoy the game!

Notes:

XBOX ONE Gamepad is highly recommended!
Stay tuned for upcoming updates to support different gamepads such as PS4 and Steam Controller.
